$comment: Beginner tips. Each names one thing to do and waits until the user does it: there is no Next. One shows at a time: the first in this order that isn't done yet, whose moment has come (when: facts that must hold), and whose anchor (an element id, or with part, a selector inside it) is on screen. doneWhen: the fact the tip's action produces; once it holds (with the rest of `when`), the tip is done, even if it never showed. Facts: songLoaded, keyChosen, playing, notePlaying (a single note held on the piano or number row), chordKeyHeld (a chord held on the A–J row), chordRow (the A–J row plays chords), dropdownOpen, chordPlaced (TourFacts in src/callouts/tour.js), plus every name in pageFacts below: true while an element matching its selector is on the page. A new tip, with a new pageFact if it needs one, is a content change only. Selectors that test attributes may use id, open, hidden, disabled, aria-pressed, aria-expanded, aria-selected, aria-checked, and aria-busy, which the tips re-check when they change. needsKeyLabels: true skips it while a demo hides key labels. needsHardwareKeyboard: true skips it on a touch screen, for a tip whose only action is a physical key. Matthew owns this wording. Revised drafts by Claude, Oct 7, 2026, for action and concision: an imperative first, at most one clause of why, a 2–4 word title.

callouts.title: Start here
callouts.text: Click a tune to begin, with your sound on.

callouts.title: Hear the tune
callouts.text: Press Play and watch each note light up as it sounds.

callouts.title: Find home by ear
callouts.text: Press Help me find it to hear the song's key, or which note the tune comes home to.

callouts.title: 1 is home
callouts.text: Press 1 to 7 on your keyboard's top row to climb the scale from home.

callouts.title: Try chords
callouts.text: Click any note on the staff to hear chords under it.

callouts.title: Chords by color
callouts.text: Press A to J to play chords. Blue circle means home; red square means tension.

callouts.title: Same tune, any key
callouts.text: Open Play it in another key, in the key box, to move the tune; the numbers stay the same.

callouts.title: Ask the tutor
callouts.text: Type a question and press Ask. It points you where to listen, not to the answer.
